title: OCaml Temporal native client signal-with-start request
description: Closed JSON document used only by the private Rust client bridge, submitted with the SIGNAL_WITH_START client call selector (#1151). The start document is embedded unchanged: its request_id deduplicates both the start and the signal, and its rpc_timeout_ms bounds the whole call (default 10 seconds). Its id_conflict_policy must not be fail, which Temporal rejects for this RPC. Its cron_schedule and start_delay_ms are forwarded (#1158); Temporal ends the delay early when another signal-with-start reaches the run. The success value is the start outcome of client-start-outcome.schema.json. Runtime validators also reject duplicate keys, NUL bytes, and strings over the 65,536-byte safety limit.
